steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the dryer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Electrical Shock Hazard. Disconnect power before accessing.

steps.title: Continue procedure
steps.body: Diagnostic mode entered (Less Dry / input beep test reviewed). Continue with component tests below.

steps.title: Diagnostic mode door check
steps.body: In diagnostic test mode, opening/closing door should produce audible beep.
steps.sourceExcerpt: In diagnostic test mode, opening/closing door should produce audible beep.

steps.title: Door switch plug pins 1–3
steps.body: Power off. Rx1: pins 1–3 closed (0 Ω) with door closed; open (OL) with door open.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Power off. Rx1: pins 1–3 closed (0 Ω) with door closed; open (OL) with door open.

steps.title: Harness neutral to P2-6 (§6-5)
steps.body: Door closed: neutral to P2-6 on control should read closed. Open with door open.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Door closed: neutral to P2-6 on control should read closed. Open with door open.

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the dryer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Electrical Shock Hazard. Disconnect power before accessing.

steps.title: Electric or gas dryer?
steps.body: MED/WED = electric dual-element; MGD/WGD = gas burner.
steps.sourceExcerpt: MED/WED = electric dual-element; MGD/WGD = gas burner.

steps.title: Electric — terminal block
steps.body: Remove rear cover plate. Verify cord at terminal block.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Remove rear cover plate. Verify cord at terminal block.

steps.title: Neutral plug to terminal block center
steps.body: Continuity from plug N to center terminal block contact.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Continuity from plug N to center terminal block contact.

steps.title: Identify L1 at block
steps.body: Note which plug terminal connects to left-most block contact (L1).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Note which plug terminal connects to left-most block contact (L1).

steps.title: L1 plug to timer BK
steps.body: Access electronic control without disconnecting board wiring. Continuity L1 plug to BK (black) on timer.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Access electronic control without disconnecting board wiring. Continuity L1 plug to BK (black) on timer.

steps.title: Neutral plug to P2-1
steps.body: Continuity from plug N to P2-1 (white) on electronic control.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Continuity from plug N to P2-1 (white) on electronic control.

steps.title: Gas — cord to harness
steps.body: Verify power cord firmly connected to wire harness.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Verify power cord firmly connected to wire harness.

steps.title: Gas — neutral to P1-2
steps.body: Continuity plug N to P1-2 (white) on electronic control.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Continuity plug N to P1-2 (white) on electronic control.

steps.title: Gas — L1 to timer BK
steps.body: Continuity L1 plug to BK (black) on timer.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Continuity L1 plug to BK (black) on timer.

steps.title: Less Dry test (live)

steps.title: Diagnostic mode — timer advances
steps.body: If Less Dry fails, enter diagnostic mode. Timer should advance continuously during test mode.

steps.body: Disconnect timer wires. Spec 3 kΩ (±2).

steps.title: Motor relay COM to P2-6
steps.body: Door open, power off for bench motor. At control: COM to P2-6 should read 1–6 Ω.
